dz: 第二次里瓦斯之战:胡安·桑塔玛利亚将威廉·沃克的虚构者所藏身的旅店烧毁.
de: Second Battle of Rivas: Juan Santamaría burns down the hostel where William Walker's filibusters are holed up.

dz: 丰特涅布劳条约结束了第六联军对拿破仑·波拿巴的战争,并迫使他第一次无条件退位.
de: The Treaty of Fontainebleau ends the War of the Sixth Coalition against Napoleon Bonaparte, and forces him to abdicate unconditionally for the first time.

de: Battle of the Basque Roads: Admiral Lord Gambier fails to support Captain Lord Cochrane, leading to an incomplete British victory over the French fleet.

de: Premiere of Johann Sebastian Bach's St Matthew Passion BWV 244b at St. Thomas Church in Leipzig, Electorate of Saxony (now Germany).

te: France and Great Britain sign the Treaty of Utrecht, bringing an end to the War of the Spanish Succession (Queen Anne's…
dz: 法国和英国签署"乌得勒支条约",结束了西班牙继承战争(后安妮之战). 英国接受腓特烈五世为西班牙国王,而腓特烈放弃对法国王位的任何要求.
de: France and Great Britain sign the Treaty of Utrecht, bringing an end to the War of the Spanish Succession (Queen Anne's War). Britain accepts Philip V as King of Spain, while Philip renounces any claim to the French throne.

dz: 威廉三世和玛丽二世在苏格兰议会同意2月12日英国决定的同一天被加冕为大不列颠的联合君主.
de: William III and Mary II are crowned as joint sovereigns of Great Britain on the same day that the Scottish Parliament concurs with the English decision of 12 February.

te: A French army defeats Habsburg forces at the Battle of Ceresole, but fails to exploit its victory.
dz: 1542–46年意大利战争:一法国军队在塞雷索尔战役中击败了哈布斯堡部队,但未能利用其胜利.
de: Italian War of 1542–46: A French army defeats Habsburg forces at the Battle of Ceresole, but fails to exploit its victory.

de: War of the League of Cambrai: Franco-Ferrarese forces led by Gaston de Foix and Alfonso I d'Este win the Battle of Ravenna against the Papal-Spanish forces.
